data_access: Validation-only selection and confirmation; Test labels unavailable

candidate_rule.screening: single-node actual-byte saving versus strong lossless state
candidate_rule.node_selection: beam search over sorted node sets
candidate_rule.encoding: selected train_raw nodes Q8; all other fields and nodes lossless
candidate_rule.fallback: strong lossless state when actual encoded bytes are not smaller

independent_model_confirmation.scope: fixed seed-1 node rule evaluated on independent Student checkpoints

limitations: Thresholds were frozen after exploratory work and are not preregistered.
Beam search is bounded by the top-8 byte-saving candidate pool and depth 4; no global-optimality claim.
The late-40% temporal audit is a confirmation check on fixed nodes, not a fully independent node-selection split.
PEMS08 does not obtain an additional compressed deployment state under the strong-lossless byte gate.
